attacks.name: Blade of Midnight
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Blood Boil
steps: After each attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Poison|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| special condition.

attacks.name: Butcher of Thors
steps: After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.

|!wild| |*Dark Curse|: After this attack is resolved, for each |!wild| in the attack roll the defender gains one of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§hex§Hex|, |§shock§Shock|, |§slow§Slow|, or |§stun§Stun|.

superPowers.name: The Dark Council (Affiliation: Cabal)
superPowers.body: When this character or an allied character Dazes or KO's an enemy character, choose another non-Dazed allied character. After the effect is resolved, the chosen character may remove 1 |!damage|, may gain 1 |!power|, and may advance |!range_small|. A character can be affected by this |!leadership| ability only once per Round.

superPowers.name: Ferocity
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by a |*Blade of Midnight| attack. After that attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage| and the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw the defender |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Cloak of Shadows
superPowers.body: After this character rolls attack, defense, or dodge dice but before the |*Resolve Criticals| step, it may spend any amount of |!power| to use this superpower. For each 1 |!power| spent, choose one |!failure| to treat as a |!critical| for the remainder of the roll.

superPowers.name: Conqueror of the Ten Realms
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

erratas.body: "Ferocity!"'s Blade of Midnight attack is not an attack action anymore but a simple attack.
"Additionally, characters cannot modify their attack dice when targeting this character with attacks." was removed from Conqueror of the Ten Realms
Stamina decreased from 10 to 9 on Healthy side, from 8 to 7 on Injured side.
"Blade of Midnight" does not have a Pierce special rule anymore.
"Butcher of Thors" can now inflict Hex.
"Ferocity" cannot Throw characters of Size 4 or more anymore.
